Bengal CID Questions TMC Leader Abhishek Banerjee's Aide in Land Case

Sumit Roy, a close aide and former personal assistant to Trinamool Congress leader Abhishek Banerjee, was questioned for approximately 10 hours by the West Bengal Criminal Investigation Department (CID). The questioning is related to a land fraud case in Salboni. The Hindu noted that 16 First Information Reports (FIRs) have been filed against Mr. Banerjee since the change of regime in West Bengal.
